details: Aga Khan Visual Archive. Gurlitt, Die Baukunst Konstantinopels, 1912, plate 24c, original printed plan and two measured sections, in the public domain.
Piyale Paşa Camii, pp. 49–52. Firsthand documentation of the 30.50 × 19.70 m harim, six domes of about 9 m diameter, lead-clad roofs, exterior buttresses and paired galleries.
Municipal heritage record identifies the former medrese and tekke as removed and the surviving türbe south of the mosque.
Monuments directorate describes the türbe as octagonal cut limestone with an octagonal drum and flattened dome.
